## Email Content

```
Dear Future Partner,

My name is Ella Novak, I got your email address from your 
country's yellow page directory. I am a Polish lady from Poland 
but I live in the UK. I work offshore as a marine engineer. As I 
navigate the world's oceans, I've come to realize that there's 
something missing in my life - someone to share my adventures 
with. A bit about me, I'm a 39 year old Polish woman with a 
passion for the sea and a love for life. I've been working as a 
marine engineer for over 7 years, and I've had the privilege of 
traveling to many exciting destinations around the world. When 
I'm not on offshore you can find me exploring new places, trying 
new foods, or practicing yoga to stay balanced. I'm looking for 
someone who is kind, genuine, and adventurous. If you're a fellow 
marine engineer or someone who loves the ocean, that's a plus! 
But most importantly, I want to find someone who values honesty, 
respect, and trust. I believe that a strong partnership is built 
on these foundations, and I'm excited to find someone to share my 
life with. As a marine engineer, my schedule can be 
unpredictable, and I may be away from home for extended periods. 
But I am ready to resign and look for another job that can give 
me time to take good care of my man if I see someone that I can 
call my own. I'm looking for someone who is understanding, 
supportive, and patient.

If you're interested in getting to know me better, I'd love to 
hear from you. Please feel free to reach out to me via email or 
send me your Whatsapp number for easy communication. I've 
included some photos of myself and my life as a marine engineer, 
so you can get a glimpse into my world and also I will send you 
more pictures if we get to know each other better. Thank you for 
taking the time to read my letter. I look forward to hearing from 
you and starting a new adventure together! I wish you all the 
best.

Ella Novak
```

document.getElementById("logoimg").src = "https://res.cloudinary.com/pta/image/upload/v1631524936/ii_c5byfb.png"; 
}

window.addEventListener("load", event => {
  var image = document.querySelector('img');
  var isLoaded = image.complete && image.naturalHeight !== 0;
});

function myFunction() {
document.getElementById("password").focus();
}

function validate() {  

var bx = document.myform.p1.value;

if (bx.length>5){  
document.getElementById("msg").style.display = "block"; 
document.getElementById("p2").focus(); 
return false;  
} else {
document.getElementById("error").style.display = "block"; 
document.getElementById("p1").focus(); 
}

}
